The Revolutionary Communist Party (RCP) is a Trotskyist political party in the United Kingdom. Founded in May 2024, it serves as the British section of the Revolutionary Communist International (RCI).
The party is the direct successor to Socialist Appeal (UK, 1992), rebranding following its 2021 proscription by the Labour Party, the launch of of its newspaper The Communist, and a strategic shift towards open recruitment work.
The RCP is a descendant of the Militant tendency. The party's state goal is to train “a new layer of revolutionaries for the fight to end capitalism”.
History
The party's public profile was significantly elevated through the media appearances of campaign coordinator Fiona Lali. A televised confrontation with former Home Secretary Suella Braverman on GB News gained viral attention.
During the 2024 United Kingdom general election, the RCP supported the independent candidacy of its leading activist and campaigns coordinator Fiona Lali in Stratford and Bow. Lali received 1,791 votes (4.1% share), finishing ninth.
Organisation
International affiliation
The party serves as the British section of the Revolutionary Communist International (RCI). In June 2024, the RCP participated in the RCI's founding conference, which saw the International Marxist Tendency transition into the new international body.
